supersedes.note: That record is left unedited, per the append-only handling this repository's decision records use once a record is treated as decided: this file supersedes only the pending-confirmation status of its actions: read entry, it does not restate or reopen the rest of that record.

source: The coordinator asked the owner in owner-chat: "Confirm `actions: read` on the publication-records workflow. My recommendation is yes; it can't write anything." The owner replied: "yes".
note: This confirms exactly the actions: read scope described in governance/decisions/publication-evidence-workflow-permissions.json's additionalPermissions entry — read-only, granted on both jobs of .github/workflows/record-publication-evidence.yml, for reading the triggering publish run's own jobs and (on the replay path) its qualified-candidate-<key> artifact. It confirms no other or broader permission, and does not reopen or modify the original contents: write / pull-requests: write decision, which remains recorded and unchanged in the superseded file.
